picked_rationale: C3 (signed dose-response α sweep) is picked over C1 (subspace decomposition) as the single Stage-2 claim because: (1) C3 directly tests the causal mechanism under study — the specificity and directionality of V_lang steering is the hypothesis's load-bearing claim, and a model-swap tests whether this signed dose-response pattern is model-specific or general; (2) C3's mechanism audit returned WARN (not N/A as for C1), meaning the mechanism intervention is active and a cross-model swap is informative about whether the steering specificity generalises; (3) the main-experiment verdict (not-supported: monotone-decreasing leg refuted, V_lang is disruptive in both directions) is more nuanced than C1's clean N/A mechanism, making the model-swap a stronger discriminator; (4) IDEA_REPORT.md identifies the language-specific subspace directionality as the core scientific claim — C3 operationalises this most directly.
